standard.name: OGC Model for Underground Data Definition and Integration (MUDDI) Part 1

claim_ceiling: This artifact maps MUDDI concepts to existing Luminous ownership boundaries. It is not a complete logical model, schema implementation, MUDDI conformance result, asset registry, survey validation, engineering approval, or authorization to disclose critical-infrastructure data.

identifier_contract.meaning: Persistent identifier of the real-world object
Persistent identifier of a representation in a dataset or data product
Identifier assigned by an implementation system

core_classes.owner: Sol-Atlas evidence/spatial envelope + external object owner
core_classes.role: common object/record geometry and identifier envelope
core_classes.caveat: ObjectID is not a Sol-Atlas-generated canonical asset ID.

core_classes.role: reference asset identity, asset type and owner-issued attributes
core_classes.caveat: Sol-Atlas is not the authoritative asset registry.

core_classes.owner: Sol-Atlas evidence graph + Mycelix / event owner
core_classes.role: time-bounded lifecycle or observation event references
core_classes.caveat: Event record does not establish that the represented physical event was correctly performed.

core_classes.role: site, service area, planning area and spatial scope
reference a network identity and revision
network membership reference for an asset
reference commodity/service conveyance with declared type and limits
core_classes.caveat: No engineering ratings are inferred by the crosswalk.

core_classes.owner: utility network owner + Sol-Atlas geometry view
core_classes.role: topology node reference with spatial evidence

core_classes.owner: utility network owner + Sol-Atlas geometry view
core_classes.role: topology edge reference with geometry revision and evidence
ducts, access chambers, valves, sensors and other supporting asset references
core_classes.caveat: Access details are classified before any display/export.

extended_concepts.role: record a time-space observation about a feature of interest and bind its supporting evidence
extended_concepts.caveat: MUDDI Observation is in the Extended Conceptual Model; extensions are optional unless adopted by the logical model.

evidence_envelope.integrity_limit: Digest binding detects changed bytes when bytes are available; it does not authenticate publisher identity or prove scientific/physical truth.

spatial_temporal_contract.coordinate_rule: No transform or merge across incompatible CRS/datum/epoch without a declared transformation and error budget.

disclosure_classes.geometry: aggregated service area/status only; no exact access points, topology, high-consequence routes or sensor locations
generalized geometry and minimum attributes for named purpose
exact scope-limited geometry for approved work and time window
highest-sensitivity geometry, dependencies and security observations; explicit approval and audit
